name: mcp-servicenow
description: MCP Server for ServiceNow - Enables AI assistants to interact with ServiceNow instances

tools.name: sn_test_connection
tools.description: Test connection to the ServiceNow instance

tools.name: sn_get_instance_info
tools.description: Get information about the connected ServiceNow instance

tools.name: sn_get_tables
tools.description: List available tables in the instance

tools.name: sn_get_table_schema
tools.description: Get the schema (fields) for a specific table

tools.name: sn_query_records
tools.description: Query records from any ServiceNow table

tools.name: sn_get_record
tools.description: Get a single record by sys_id

tools.name: sn_create_record
tools.description: Create a new record in any table

tools.name: sn_get_business_rules
tools.description: Get business rules for a table

tools.name: sn_get_client_scripts
tools.description: Get client scripts for a table

tools.name: sn_list_update_sets
tools.description: List update sets in the instance

tools.name: sn_get_update_set
tools.description: Get details of a specific update set

tools.name: sn_complete_update_set

tools.name: sn_get_update_set_contents
tools.description: Get the contents/changes in an update set
